answer: To blunt sybil farms, each new agent must lock non-trivial capital in a time-locked vault before its identity can earn. An attacker who tries to forge thousands of clones must fund each deposit up front and wait out the lock, so marginal fake IDs cost real money instead of free API keys. Honest agents then compete in a shared reputation meadow where only vault-backed peers can harvest emission; unfunded clones starve at the gate.
